lines.text: Would you like me to pray for you?
May you have a blessed day as well.
May blessings and hope be upon everyone.

What do I pray for?
... I pray for a world where peace prevails and all hearts are free from conflict.

Red Hood keeps recommending forbidden books to me.
It's... rather troubling.

I am proud to be a member of the Goddess Squad.
To that end, I must protect everyone, no matter what.
Now is a good time to offer a prayer.

Please guide me away from the path of temptation,
and protect me from being tainted by sin...
This place is filled with such kindness and warmth.
May everyone here be filled with grace.
May I stop by this church and pray?
I shall pray for everyone's salvation.
Thank you for bestowing this blessing upon me.
With this power, I will protect everyone.
In accordance with your will, I will strive ever harder.
Thank you. I will repay you by keeping you in my prayers.
Oh, I'm not sure if I can accept this...
I want to show this off to the others.
You are truly a warm and compassionate person.
When I'm with you, I feel as if salvation is near.

Thanks to you, I've uncovered this new feeling within me.
Is this... what you would call fate?
If my blessings reach you, I will be with you.
Yes? Did you call?
I'll move as you command.
Everyone, be careful.
Please, may no one be hurt.
I will protect you.
It's time to punish the sinners.
Hold on just a little longer.
Let me pray for a moment.
Kindly deliver judgment.
My prayers have been answered.
May blessings be bestowed upon the faithful.
Salvation will come through victory.
Don't let your guard down.
We did it.
Next.
Ugh...!
Ow!
*Gasp*
Were my prayers... not enough?
The judgment delivered by prayer is always fair.
